create.name: Camilla Sacre-Dallerup
create.bio:
Camilla Sacre-Dallerup is a meditation teacher, hypnotherapist and life coach based in Los Angeles, where she founded Zenme Coaching more than a decade ago. Before coaching she was a professional ballroom dancer and one of the first professionals on the BBC's Strictly Come Dancing, and she has since judged Dancing With The Stars in New Zealand. She says the inner tools she relied on through competition, a very public break-up and a change of career are the ones she now teaches.

Her coaching draws on what she calls a 7-System Mind Method, combining meditation, hypnosis, NLP, chakra work, reiki, mindfulness and breathwork, with sessions in person or over video. She has taught classes at Unplug Meditation in Los Angeles and runs sound baths with her husband, Kevin Sacre. Her books are Dream, Believe, Succeed, Reinvent Me and It's Not You, It's Me, which centres on self-love as the base for every other relationship. She hosts the podcast Me, My Relationships & I, sells short self-paced courses on self-love and abundance, and records guided meditations and affirmations for Insight Timer and her own Zenme app.

videos.title: Connecting to your inner guidance system

books.title: It's Not You, It's Me: How to Heal Your Relationship with Yourself and Others
books.author: Camilla Sacre-Dallerup
books.description: Camilla's guide to changing repeated patterns in close relationships by starting with the one you have with yourself. It is built around self-awareness, self-acceptance, self-love and self-care, with questions and exercises in each chapter.

books.title: Reinvent Me: How to Transform Your Life & Career
books.author: Camilla Sacre-Dallerup
books.description: An eight-step programme for changing direction in work or life, drawn from Camilla's own move from dancing to coaching. Each step comes with exercises, stories from others who made a change, and affirmations.

courses.title: Learn to Love Yourself in Just 10 Days
courses.description: A ten-day self-paced online course on building a kinder relationship with yourself, using guided visualisations, meditations, reframing, mantras and affirmations, and chakra work.

courses.title: Creating Your First Abundance Practice
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course of short daily sessions that introduce an abundance practice through visualisation, affirmations, gratitude, journalling and NLP-based exercises, including the law of attraction.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Bespoke Meditations & Affirmations
courses.description: A personal guided recording made by Camilla around a theme and key words you choose, delivered by email; it can be given as a gift.

free_resources.title: Camilla Sacre-Dallerup on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations, body scans and affirmations from Camilla, including short calming practices and evening self-worth affirmations. Listen free in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Free Mind Tools: Meditation Experiences
free_resources.description: Free guided meditation series from Camilla, sent by email: a seven-day series for beginners, a 21-day habit series and a morning meditation.
